/* 공통팀 유민상 isry.itgcms.itgBrd.mapper.itgBrdCmnMapper.selectCtgtybInstList 공통팀 유민상 */
SELECT A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD , (SELECT B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 B WHERE B.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD' AND B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD) AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_NM FROM SAC110 A WHERE 1=1 AND A.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'UNITY_BBSCTT_CTGRYB_SE_CD' AND A.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = #{UNITY_BBSCTT_CTGRYB_SE_CD} ORDER BY A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD
SELECT INST_NO AS CMMNS_CD_VALUE , INST_NM AS CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM , UP_INST_NO , RGN_CD FROM SAA000 WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND APRV_YN = 'Y' AND INST_NO = #{instNo}

/* 공통팀 유민상 isry.itgcms.itgBrd.mapper.itgBrdCmnMapper.selectDeptCodeList 공통팀 유민상 */
SELECT INST_NO AS PARENT_CD , DEPT_CD AS CMMNS_CD_VALUE , DEPT_NM AS CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAA300 WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY INST_NO

/* 공통팀 유민상 isry.itgcms.itgBrd.mapper.itgBrdCmnMapper.selectCtpvCodeList 공통팀 유민상 */
SELECT CTPV_SE_CD , CTPV_NM FROM SAA020 WHERE 1=1 AND NVL(DEL_YN, 'N') != 'Y' GROUP BY CTPV_SE_CD, CTPV_NM ORDER BY CTPV_SE_CD

/* 공통팀 유민상 isry.itgcms.itgBrd.mapper.itgBrdCmnMapper.selectSggCodeList 공통팀 유민상 */
SELECT CTPV_SE_CD , SGG_CD , SGG_NM FROM SAA020 WHERE 1=1 AND NVL(DEL_YN, 'N') != 'Y' ORDER BY SRTNG_SQNCE

/* 게시글 상세조회 isry.itgcms.itgBrd.mapper.itgBrdCmnMapper.selectItgBrdDtlList 공통팀 유민상 */ SELECT UNITY_BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , UNITY_BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD , UNITY_BBSCTT_TYPE_SN , UNITY_BBSCTT_CTGRYB_SE_CD , CD_PRVSON_ETC_NM , IMPRTN_NTC_YN , OGDP_INST_NO , (SELECT INST_NM FROM SAA000 WHERE INST_NO = OGDP_INST_NO) AS OGDP_INST_NM , OGDP_DEPT_CD , PSTG_BGNG_YMD , PSTG_END_YMD , UNITY_BBSCTT_TTL_NM , UNITY_BBSCTT_CN , RLS_YN , RDCNT_NOCS , DEC_B64(CTTPC_ENCPT) AS CTTPC_ENCPT , ATFINO , CLLR_REG_YN , ACTVT_NOCS , DEC_B64(SA_FN_GET_NAME(FRST_RGTR_ID)) AS FRST_RGTR_NM , FRST_RGTR_ID , TO_CHAR(FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS FRST_REG_DT FROM SBA130 WHERE 1=1 AND UNITY_BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{UNITY_BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}

/* 게시글 출력 시스템 조회 isry.itgcms.itgBrd.mapper.itgBrdCmnMapper.selectItgBrdDtlList 공통팀 유민상 */ SELECT A.UNITY_BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD , (SELECT B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 B WHERE B.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD' AND B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD) AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_NM FROM SBA132 A WHERE 1=1 AND A.UNITY_BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{UNITY_BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}
